name: Routine Dental Cleaning
summary: A thorough cleaning that removes plaque and tartar to keep your teeth and gums healthy.

name: Digital X-Ray
summary: Low-radiation digital images that help us spot problems below the surface early.

name: Fluoride Treatment
summary: A protective fluoride application that strengthens enamel and helps prevent cavities.

name: Tooth Filling
summary: Repair a cavity with a tooth-colored filling that restores shape and function.

name: Root Canal Therapy
summary: Remove infected tissue inside the tooth to relieve pain and save the natural tooth.

name: Dental Crown
summary: A custom cap that covers and protects a damaged or weakened tooth.

name: Tooth Extraction
summary: Safe removal of a damaged, decayed, or problem tooth under local anesthesia.

name: Wisdom Tooth Removal
summary: Removal of impacted or painful wisdom teeth with careful post-care guidance.

name: Dental Implant
summary: A permanent titanium root and crown that replaces a missing tooth.

name: Teeth Whitening
summary: Professional whitening that brightens your smile several shades in a single visit.

name: Porcelain Veneers
summary: Thin porcelain shells that reshape and brighten the front of your teeth.

name: Emergency Toothache Visit
summary: Same-day evaluation and pain relief for severe toothache or swelling.

name: Broken Tooth Repair
summary: Urgent repair for a chipped, cracked, or knocked-out tooth.

name: New Patient Consultation
summary: A first visit with an exam and a personalized treatment plan.

name: VIP Smile Makeover Package
summary: An invitation-only full smile redesign combining whitening, veneers, and contouring.
